notes:
November's theme is Graphite, all greys so only meaningful colour is left, and a private clipboard now stays out of Windows' clipboard history when a prompt takes it in. Builds on [v0.2.30](https://github.com/bekalpaslan/promptline/releases/tag/v0.2.30).

### Themes

- **Graphite**, November's theme, chosen from five candidates put to a public vote, under Settings → Appearance → Theme: greys only, in both modes, so the only colour left on screen is colour that means something: errors, warnings, placeholders and your tags.
- Graphite fills Paste, Apply and Import with near-white on dark and near-black on light.
- Tags are outlines in their hue with no fill.
- Picking a theme leaves the font and the mode where they were, as before.

### Privacy

- **A private clipboard stays private in the prompt.** When a prompt takes in something your password manager copied as private, the prompt is now marked private too, so Windows keeps it out of clipboard history (Win+V) and doesn't sync it to your other devices. Ordinary prompts still appear in clipboard history as before. Nothing Promptline sends over the network changes.

### Your library

- **A library saved with a byte order mark loads.** If an editor saved `snippets.json` or `config.json` with a byte order mark, Promptline used to set the file aside as damaged and start with an empty library. It now reads it as it is.
- **Importing into "work" beside a pack called "Work" lands in Work**, and respects its lock, instead of making a second pack with the same name in another case.
- **Renaming a pack can no longer split it in two** when saving fails halfway; everything goes back to the old name.
- **Move up and Move down no longer undo a change made meanwhile** in the other window, such as a use count from a paste.
- **A placeholder named `{{constructor}}` is an ordinary placeholder**, asked for like any other, instead of pasting program text.

### Popup

- **Pressing Enter twice in the new-prompt form saves one prompt**, not two.
- **Ctrl+Z after a failed undo can try again**; the deleted prompt is no longer lost when the first restore doesn't save.
- **The popup and the manager's sidebar sit 8 px from the window edge** instead of 12, so the list starts closer to the frame.

### Manager and settings

- **Report a bug from Settings → About.** A **Report a bug** button opens a new issue on GitHub in your browser (you'll need a GitHub account to file it), and the version the form asks for is shown beside it. It is the second link the app can open, after the coffee page.
- **A failed save stops what was about to follow it.** Creating a pack or group no longer opens one that wasn't saved, and Settings no longer says "Theme updated" beside the error.
- **If an upgrade couldn't carry your old settings over, Promptline now leaves `config.json` alone for that whole session** so the next launch can try again; a settings change says why it wasn't saved instead of writing over them.

### Updates

- **A failed update install can be retried.** After a download or signature failure, Install works again instead of answering "No update is waiting".
